title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Cancellation SR-26 Schedule: Days by Certificate Type
content:
On a cancellation SR-26 under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), cancellation type notice days are added to the cancellation run-off. This applies to the SR-26 for a certificate whose backing term was cancelled and has not been reinstated. The days follow the certificate type, which fixes the kind of backing term the certificate rests on.

| Certificate type and backing term | Cancellation type notice days |
|---|---|
| Owner-Operator certificate on an Owner Auto Policy backing term | 2 days |
| Operator certificate on a Named Non-Owner Policy backing term | 1 day |
| Owner certificate | none |

**Reading the table**

- *SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate on an Owner Auto Policy term:* 2 days.
- *FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate on an Owner Auto Policy term:* also 2 days. The form is not read by this table.
- *SR-22 Operator Certificate on a Named Non-Owner Policy term:* 1 day.
- *SR-22 Owner Certificate:* no days.
